name: ~Oume Tokkai~ Chikan Densha H-cup Wakazuma Maina
original_name: ～追雌特快～痴漢電車Hカップ若妻まいな
source:
One day, when Kudo looks for someone to molest at the platform, he finds a pretty girl. He decides to follow behind her and gets on the train. Just when he takes action, he finds that a man in front of her tries to molest her. Kudo waits for a while and catches him. The girl, Maina, says thank you to Kudo and leaves the train without knowing his purpose. Days later, he starts molesting Maina on the train....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
